<h2>Summarise Fossil-Core Age Iterations</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Interpolates bounded batches of fossil age-model iterations and returns
median community proportions across all iterations.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>.summarise_fossil_core_age_iterations(
  dataset_name,
  data_community,
  data_age_uncertainty,
  max_expanded_rows,
  list_interpolation_arguments,
  interpolate_grouped_time_series_function
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="dataset_name">dataset_name</code></td>
<td>
<p>Fossil-core dataset identifier.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_community">data_community</code></td>
<td>
<p>Nested community proportions for one fossil core.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_age_uncertainty">data_age_uncertainty</code></td>
<td>
<p>Nested age-model iteration records for the same fossil core.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="max_expanded_rows">max_expanded_rows</code></td>
<td>
<p>Maximum approximate expanded observation rows processed per batch.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="list_interpolation_arguments">list_interpolation_arguments</code></td>
<td>
<p>Additional arguments forwarded to [interpolate_grouped_time_series()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="interpolate_grouped_time_series_function">interpolate_grouped_time_series_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Grouped interpolation function supplied explicitly for dependency-safe
execution inside a dynamic target branch.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Median interpolated proportions by dataset, taxon, and age.
</p>

</main>
